description: Cyclotourisme - liaisons cyclables - Centre-Val de Loire is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. A route is a proposal for an unmarked route to reach a point of interest or another route. Links differ from antennas in their unscheduled character. We do not have many connections in the Centre region. A small description should be provided for each link, specifying what it achieves. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling - cycling links - Centre-Val de Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include tourisme, itinéraires, cyclotourisme, itinéraires cyclables, vélotourisme. The listing shows 2021-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
